description:
Elite Estate Agents are proud to present this simply stunning four-bedroom semi-detached dormer home to the residential sales market. 7 Kilmalogue Downs offers the perfect blend of modern style and comfort with beautifully appointed interiors and superior finishes. Presented to an excellent standard, the property combines generous proportions with a warm and welcoming atmosphere, creating a home that is both elegant and inviting.

7 Kilmalogue Downs is superbly located on the Clonygowan Road in Portarlington in a quiet cul de sac of only 14 houses.

On entering, you are greeted by a bright and spacious hallway with a double height ceiling that sets the tone for the rest of the property. The generous living room provides an elegant and comfortable space for relaxing and entertaining, with large windows allowing an abundance of natural light to fill the room.

To the rear, the impressive kitchen and dining area forms the heart of the home. With bespoke fitted units, clever storage options and plenty of room for family dining, it is an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. Patio doors open onto the private rear garden, creating a wonderful connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces. A block built shed and walled boundaries finish the garden area perfectly. A separate pantry/utility room and downstairs double bedroom and full bathroom with shower add further convenience.

Upstairs, there are three beautifully proportioned bedrooms. The main bedroom offers a peaceful retreat and benefits from a stylish en-suite with a beautiful finish, while the remaining bedrooms provide excellent flexibility for children, guests, a home office or hobbies. A modern family bathroom with stylish panelling and contemporary tiles and fittings completes the first floor.

Outside, the property is equally appealing. The front provides off-street parking and an attractive approach, while the private rear garden offers a lovely space to enjoy.

With its bright interiors, generous proportions measuring 134 square meters, attractive outdoor space and thoughtful layout, this is a wonderful home that combines comfort, style and functionality in equal measure.

Viewing of this special property is very highly recommended.
